remarks: Enjoy the Comfort of a Single-Family Home in a Private In-Law Unit! This beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse-style unit is just a stone's throw from all that Downtown Stamford has to offer! The main level features an open-concept living room and dining area with direct access to a private deck-perfect for entertaining. The bright eat-in kitchen boasts granite countertops, brand-new cabinetry, and modern appliances. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a private full bath. The full basement provides ample storage and includes convenient access to laundry facilities.  Don't miss out on this move-in-ready gem that blends style, space, and location!
